chunks.title: JobNet case study
chunks.text: Applying across many AI and engineering boards by hand is slow, and tools that submit on their own are unsafe. The job was to shorten the research and drafting loop without giving the system permission to apply or send mail.

chunks.title: JobNet case study
chunks.text: Designed and operated the pipeline. Set a daily 20:00 SAST scrape, then a rank against the case studies. The previous run is mailed at 15:00 SAST. Kept a human confirm step before any submit. The system queues work; it does not apply. Added inbox watching so replies can be noticed, with notify paths that still require a person to send. Published a live read-only shortlist so a reviewer can see the pipeline without touching a mailbox.

chunks.text: A portfolio assistant is easy to fake with a browser key. The engineering problem was a real model call, a swap-able provider, a safe public surface, and an honest screen when the service is down.

chunks.title: Mercatus Assist & THINK case study
chunks.text: Built the API, the proxy, and the workspace. Shipped an ASP.NET Core 8 minimal API in C# that calls Gemini through an OpenAI-compatible chat completions client, so the provider can change in config. Ran that API as a systemd service on an Ubuntu VPS, behind nginx, with the static site behind Cloudflare. Put a same-origin proxy in front so the API key stays on the server. Built THINK as a React 19, Vite, and TypeScript workspace: chat, image, live voice over WebSocket, plus sites, code, and a learning path. Labelled the fallback. If the live robot is unhealthy, the UI says it is demo coaching instead of pretending.

Feature What it does Honest simplification Tickers Thompson sampling orders notices (urgent first) from your clicks (localStorage gm_ts ); wire slows 1.6× when a metric is out of band (\ z\ 2) Beta draws via uniform order statistics, per notice kind, not per item Palette Hashed char-trigram TF-IDF cosine + a small synonym lexicon + the old lexical score Not neural; WebGPU transformers.js + mxbai embeddings is a future flag (not vendored) Shortcuts ? overlay predicts the next tab (first-order Markov on your own desk:open sequence, gm_mk ) No smoothing beyond counts Notifications Incident clustering (2+ alerts on one vehicle in 6 h) and smart snooze 60 min × (1 + Σ 0.5^(age/72 h)) , cap 24 h / 2 h urgent Fixed window grouping, not HDBSCAN Map Constant-velocity Kalman smoothing; impossible jumps ( 160 km/h) rejected, harsh brake/accel ( 3 m/s²) circled Forward pass only (no RTS smoother); PMTiles/MapLibre basemap is future Ledger Merkle root over entry hashes; rubber-stamp velocity ( 3 approvals/5 min); threshold-split detector (within 8% under a cap, 2+ per vehicle in 7 d) One planted EXAMPLE split so the detector has something to show What-if 500-resample bootstrap 95% CIs; Pareto frontier over a 5×6 auto-approve × tolerance grid Grid dominance, not NSGA-II; quotes use seeded EXAMPLE inflation Red pen Duplicate-labour overlap (same code or token Jaccard ≥0.5 within 60 d) with word highlights and lift drivers Bag-of-words, no NLP model Why Additive attributions (signals sum to the score) + greedy counterfactual + tier counterfactual, with cited rows The rule score is additive, so this is exact; no TreeSHAP/DiCE Command bar Intent + slot parsing ( Hilux claims over ten thousand rand in Soweto ) Regex/lexicon, not an LLM Night APCA (W3 0.0.98G) contrast check; red stamps get an opaque paper chip when \ Lc\ < 60 Checks the stamp pair only Radar Weibull 30-day fault probability with 80/95% bands Shape/scale per vehicle kind are EXAMPLE parameters KPI Changepoint marker (binary segmentation, BIC penalty) + 3-day linear forecast fan PELT-lite, linear trend Daily edition "Editor's picks" via greedy facility location (non-redundant), each with a chained hash Greedy (1−1/e), token similarity Compare Empirical Bayes Beta-Binomial counter-offer rate with a 95% upper bound Method-of-moments prior; counts are EXAMPLE Drag guard A fast (<700 ms) drop of a high-risk card (≥80% of the hold threshold) on Approve asks to confirm and shows the top 2 risks Rule threshold, not a learned model Skipped on purpose: Double ML, TreeSHAP/DiCE libraries, HDBSCAN, NSGA-II proper (heavy dependencies, little gain on demo data).
